Northwind Clockworks is a fictional practice note used only to test the portfolio build. The on-call owner restarts the fictional worker, checks the staging cluster, and writes a short handoff.

The next shift reads that handoff in the fictional logbook. Nothing here is a real employer, a real person, or a real system.
